title: わをん・さいごの おと
jp: わ行 ・ gojuon row 10 (FINALE) ・ the last sounds ・ male / koto
eyebrow: Row 10 · わをん · The last sounds
blurb: The finale of the gojuon — わ を ん, the last row. It can't be a normal song: only わ starts words, を is only the object particle (always "o"), and ん never begins a word — it ends them. So instead of three theme-variations this is one graduation "last sounds" song: わ-words in sentences, a を beat that celebrates the little joiner you've used all series, a ん beat for the sound that finishes words, and a whole-gojuon victory lap — one beloved word from every row, あ→ら, you can read them all now. This is the male / koto cut — a calm, elegant send-off; the same finale is rendered in all three house voices (Strategy B).
concept: わ行 is the last row, and it is special. Only わ is a word-starter (わに, わし, わた…). を is only the object particle — essentially never begins a word, always read "o" (findings F-16). ん never starts a word either; it only ends syllables and words (ぱん, みかん, きりん). So you can't make 3 groups × 3 words — わ行 needs a different design.

The design: a graduation "last sounds" song. A わ teach (six わ-words, each in a small sentence — same onset blends, so context is essential, F-10), then a を beat that shows the joiner doing its job in already-known sentences (りんご を たべる, うた を うたう), then a ん beat for the finisher (おいしい ぱん, あまい みかん), and a whole-gojuon REVIEW — one word from every earlier row (あさ・かに・さかな・つき・ねこ・ほし・みかん・やぎ・りんご) recombined into a ぜんぶ よめた！ victory lap. The ultimate F-13 payoff.

This is the male / koto cut. The finale is written once and rendered in all three house voices — Female (city pop), Male (koto), Kids (graduation singalong) — Strategy B in personas.md. The male koto voice makes the finale a calm, elegant send-off: the same words, wound down. The refrain わ を ん lands last in every verse (F-07); the closing sweep あ か さ た な は ま や ら わ を ん is the series taking one last breath.
